steps.name: named-trace-verdict
steps.action: classification of the -120 / +120 pair against the metric dictionary and the reversal code path

mechanism: Original 6aed318d257b892b04a8b048: date=2026-11-20T10:00:00.000Z (B1 walk created it with date = booking pickup 2026-11-20, walk.mjs: date: FROM), direction credit, amount 120; after cleanup reversal its status is 'reversed' so reportController's status:Posted match excludes it in EVERY window, whatever its date.

Reversal 6aed35d33ded07b5f333f92a: date=2026-11-06T02:05:07.283Z (reverseRentalPayment defaults the reversal date to new Date() at cleanup time, 2026-11-06), direction debit, amount 120, status 'posted', reversedFrom=6aed318d257b892b04a8b048. It is counted by the Posted signed sum as -120 in every window containing 2026-11-06.

reportController.ts:63: payments aggregate = { supplier, date in window, status: Posted } with debit -> -amount. The pair therefore contributes -120 (not 0) to revenueCollected in the B1 window and in any window covering the reversal date, including a window covering BOTH records (W_BOTH_WIDE measured -120): the annulment nets to zero in NO window that shows the reversal.

receivable (reportController build): max(0, rentalTotal(bookings overlapping window, status nin void/cancelled) - rentInWindow). B1 deleted its booking and voided its invoice, so the fixture rentalTotal is gone; but rentInWindow for Nov carries the lone -120 debit, so receivable = (other contracts' rentalTotal) - (-120) = baseline + 120. Hand-check for W_NOV_B1: rentalTotal=4350, rent=-120, receivable=4470. The +120 is owed by nobody: it is the arithmetic shadow of the unpaired debit.

Same double-undo in every Posted-only signed-sum consumer: ledger.ts getRecordedPurposeTotal (a reversed 120 payment on a live 300 contract would leave recorded = -120, remaining = 420) and contractReceivable.ts (postedPayments = -120, outstanding = total + 120, clamped only at >= 0). Only invoicePayment.ts escapes, because it sums only the invoice-linked payment IDs and the reversal is never linked.

Root cause: backend/src/utils/ledger.ts reverseRentalPayment performs BOTH annulment mechanisms at once - it flips the original to status Reversed (removing the credit from every Posted sum) AND posts a compensating Debit with status Posted (adding -amount to every Posted sum). Either mechanism alone nets to zero; together they net to -amount.
observed.classification: DEFECT (not correct windowed accounting). A fully reversed payment must net to zero in unwindowed balances in all states, and to zero in any report window covering both entries; here it nets to -120 in the measured window and +120 phantom receivable persists after the booking and invoice are gone. The cross-period dating (original value-dated 2026-11-20, reversal dated at reversal time 2026-11-06) is ordinary cash-basis contra timing and is NOT the defect; the status flip combined with the Posted contra debit is.
observed.fixPlan: Minimal, pattern-following: in reverseRentalPayment, create the reversal debit with status Reversed as well (the annulled pair carries Reversed on both records), so every Posted-only signed sum nets the pair to exactly zero in every window and balance, while both records stay fully visible in payment lists with direction/reversedFrom audit fields. All existing test assertions are preserved (reversal body direction/purpose/reversedFrom, replay idempotency, original status Reversed, invoice recompute to the remaining linked payments). Also fix the sibling propagation gap found in code review for the B2 story: confirmRentalPayment never recomputes linked invoices (reverseRentalPayment does), leaving invoice paidAmount stale after an accountant confirms a pending payment - add the same linked-invoice recompute loop there. Historical data note: the B1 debit already stored as Posted is not rewritten by the code fix; it remains as disclosed residue in the Nov window (no payment edit/delete route exists).

defects.title: Payment reversal double-undo: annulled pair nets to -amount in every Posted-only signed sum
defects.severity: money coherence defect (Task-1 named trace + walk step 10)
defects.rootCause: backend/src/utils/ledger.ts reverseRentalPayment flips the original to status Reversed (removing its credit from every Posted-only signed sum) AND creates the compensating debit with status Posted (adding -amount to the same sums). Consumers: reportController.ts:63 (windowed revenue/receivable/margin), contractReceivable.ts:29-56 (contract outstanding), ledger.ts getRecordedPurposeTotal (remaining-balance guard), admin Payments.tsx postedNetTotal.
defects.evidence: Trace T1-1/T1-2: B1 pair (original 6aed318d257b892b04a8b048 credit 120 date 2026-11-20 status reversed; reversal 6aed35d33ded07b5f333f92a debit 120 date 2026-11-06 status posted) contributes -120 to revenue in the B1 Nov window and in a wide Oct-Dec window containing BOTH records; receivable 4470 = 4350 - (-120). Walk S10 (live, 4000 MAD): backendPostedRent -4000, contract outstanding 16000 on a 12000 contract, Nov revenue -4000 / receivable +4000 across the reversal.
defects.fix: ledger.ts: reversal debit is created with status Reversed (annulled pair carries Reversed on both records); see fix.mjs + FIX step. Verified in V1b/V2.

defects.title: Confirming a pending payment never recomputes linked invoices (invoice paidAmount goes stale)
defects.rootCause: backend/src/utils/ledger.ts confirmRentalPayment posts the payment but, unlike reverseRentalPayment, never calls recomputeInvoicePayment for invoices linked to the payment (utils/invoicePayment.ts). Reports invoicedPaid sums the stored invoice.paidAmount, so it goes stale the same way.
defects.evidence: Walk S8: accountant confirms the 4000 payment (posted; contract outstanding 8000; report revenue +4000; caisse +4000) but the linked invoice still reads paidAmount 0 / unpaid and report invoicedPaid delta stays 0.
defects.fix: ledger.ts: confirmRentalPayment mirrors the reversal path and recomputes every linked invoice after posting; see fix.mjs + FIX step. Verified in V1a.

defects.title: Payments page amount-due counts pending (and reversed-original) payments as received
defects.severity: money coherence defect, admin frontend (walk step 4)
defects.rootCause: admin/src/pages/Payments.tsx paymentTotals reduce sums every payment for a booking regardless of status (direction-signed only), so a counter-agent PENDING entry reduces the page amount-due/remaining immediately, contradicting decision 1.5 (pending entries never count toward recorded totals) and every backend consumer (Posted-only). Its sibling postedNetTotal skips only status reversed and also counts pending. After a reversal the same status-blind sum is right only by accident (it counts both the reversed credit and the Posted debit).
defects.evidence: Walk S4: with the 4000 payment pending, page-formula remaining = 8000 while backend outstanding = 12000 and reports revenue delta = 0. Walk S10: page-formula remaining = 12000 (accidentally correct) while the page postedNet for the booking = -4000.
defects.fix: Payments.tsx: paymentTotals and postedNetTotal count only Posted (or legacy status-less) payments, mirroring backend postedMatch semantics; see fix-admin step. (Separate admin build/layer.)

observations.title: Payment reversal does not propagate to the caisse (separate ledgers, no movement-reversal route)
observations.evidence: Walk S10: after the rental payment reversal, cash session delta stayed +2500 and bank +1500. RentalPayment and CashMovement share no link; CashMovement has no reverse/delete route, so the drawer correction is a manual offsetting movement (performed at cleanup, labeled GAQ12B2-OFFSET-*). Recorded as an observation/design note, not fixed.

observations.title: Confirm endpoints are API-only: the admin UI exposes no confirm action for pending payments or cash movements
observations.evidence: admin/src/services/RentalPaymentService.ts has list/create/reverse only; CashService.ts has no confirmMovement call, although both backend routes exist and are exercised in this walk. Pending entries therefore cannot be confirmed from the shipped UI. Observation only.
